newsitem.title: FRANCE: Danone expands Chinese beer operations.
newsitem.headline: Danone expands Chinese beer operations.

text.p: French food group Danone said on Thursday it had taken a majority stake in China's fifth biggest brewer, Wuhan Dongxihu Beer Company.
This is Danone Group's second operation in the Chinese beer market in the past few months, following the creation of joint ventures with the Haomen brewery announced in January this year.
The combined production of Haomen and Dongxihu will place Danone in fourth position in this market, already the largest section of the food and beverage market in China, Danone said in a statement.
Danone said China is expected to be the world's largest beer market in the year 2000 with sales volumes estimated at over 200 million hectoliters.
Based in Wuhan, Hubei Province, Dongxihu had 1995 output totalling around 2.9 million hectoliters.
Danone is the largest beer producer in France, Italy and Spain and number two in Belgium and Europe overall. Its operations in China also include biscuits and dairy products.
